say:1:1411424001:1.text: I just heard another explosion. Are you guys alright?
say:1:1411424001:1.source_cn: 刚刚我又听见爆炸声了，你们还好吗？

say:2:1411424002:1.text: We're fine. It was that Hypo... I mean, little girl that's been causing all the trouble.
say:2:1411424002:1.source_cn: 没事，是那个恶魔……我是说那个小丫头干的。

say:3:1411424003:1.text: Oh, so you've met Kulu, huh?
say:3:1411424003:1.source_cn: 哦？你们也碰上库露露了吗？

choice_prompt:4:1411424003.text: Oh, so you've met Kulu, huh?
choice_prompt:4:1411424003.source_cn: 哦？你们也碰上库露露了吗？

say:5:1411424004:1.text: She's become well-known among our crew these past two days. Everyone likes her.
say:5:1411424004:1.source_cn: 她这两天在我们这很出名啊！毕竟她性格挺好的。
say:5:1411424004:1.male: She's become well-known among our crew these past two days. Everyone likes her.
say:5:1411424004:1.female: She's become well-known among our crew these past two days. Everyone likes her.

say:7:1411424006:1.text: Yeah, most of the pointy-eared tall folk are too uppity. They think their farts don't stink.
say:7:1411424006:1.source_cn: 是啊，你也见过那帮尖耳朵吧？一个个装腔作势拿腔拿调的。

say:8:1411424007:1.text: But Kulu? She's honest, sharp, and actually asks questions when she doesn't get something. People warmed up to her fast.
say:8:1411424007:1.source_cn: 但是那小丫头就很直率，又开朗，不懂的也会问，大家都挺喜...

say:11:1411424009:1.text: Come to think of it, when everyone was arguing with Kulu just now, Zanie didn't say anything.
say:11:1411424009:1.source_cn: 说起来，刚刚跟库露露吵架的时候，祖娅居然一句话都没说。

say:12:1411424010:1.text: Kids that age are headaches. They're loud and rebellious. They never listen to anything you say and think they're the best in the world.
say:12:1411424010:1.source_cn: 我最头疼这个年龄段的小孩了，又叛逆，又闹腾，说什么都不...

say:13:1411424011:1.text: But you look the same age as her...

say:14:1411424012:1.text: Yeah, and don't you know why I look like this?
say:14:1411424012:1.source_cn: 唉，你看我长这样还不明白？

say:15:1411424013:0.text: When I was her age, I was messing around and accidentally drank some dragon egg essence. Now I'll look like this forever.
say:15:1411424013:0.source_cn: 我在当年那个年纪要是好惹，会误喝龙蛋清让自己变成这模样吗？

choice_prompt:16:1411424013.text: When I was her age, I was messing around and accidentally drank some dragon egg essence. Now I'll look like this forever.
choice_prompt:16:1411424013.source_cn: 我在当年那个年纪要是好惹，会误喝龙蛋清让自己变成这模样吗？

say:17:1411424014:1.text: But you guys were getting along just fine. So why'd she go wild with the bombs?
say:17:1411424014:1.source_cn: 所以，你们之前既然相处得不错，那库露露为什么会翻脸扔炸弹？

say:19:1411424015:1.text: Well, she told us she was good with explosions—showed us, even. She really was amazing at it!
say:19:1411424015:1.source_cn: 是这样，我们跟库露露聊天，她说她很擅长爆炸，给我们表演...

say:20:1411424016:1.text: We asked her to help blow open some blocked tunnels, but when we tried blasting a new one, things went wrong.
say:20:1411424016:1.source_cn: 我们就托她接着帮忙炸几个地方，结果就之前开一处新矿山的...

say:21:1411424017:1.text: As a result, half of the mountain fell off, and work had to be stopped. Several dwarves were injured.
say:21:1411424017:1.source_cn: 结果轰！的一声，整座山掉了半个头，结果不得不停工，还有...

say:22:1411424018:1.text: That sounds like an accident. She didn't mean for it to happen...
say:22:1411424018:1.source_cn: 这……听起来像是事故，不太像是故意的啊？

say:23:1411424019:1.text: Yeah, we know. Everyone tried to reassure her, but then she snapped.
say:23:1411424019:1.source_cn: 谁说不是呢，大家还安慰她，结果她反而恼火了！

say:24:1411424020:1.text: She started saying things like "I'm very evil!" and "I did it on purpose!", and started dropping bombs everywhere.
say:24:1411424020:1.source_cn: 突然说什么“我就是故意炸的！”“我很邪恶！我要炸烂所有...

say:25:1411424021:1.text: It's hard to explain... She's acting out, yeah, but she doesn't feel truly evil.
say:25:1411424021:1.source_cn: ……该怎么说呢，确实是在做坏事，但感觉和邪恶好像关系不大……

say:26:1411424022:1.text: Yeah, we know that. Compared to us, she's just a baby. Her bombs aren't that scary anyway.
say:26:1411424022:1.source_cn: 哎，谁说不是，不就是小女孩儿要面子嘛！她那点炸弹威力也...

say:27:1411424023:1.text: Next to those dainty pointy-eared maidens who gasp at a single curse, a little fire in her feels downright refreshing. Deep down, she's got a good heart.
say:27:1411424023:1.source_cn: 而且跟那些说错句话就皱眉头的尖耳朵比，她发个小脾气也挺...

say:28:1411424024:1.text: Anyway, there was some rubble, and this fella hurt his leg. We need to rest here for a bit before we can move on...
say:28:1411424024:1.source_cn: 就是刚刚这边有碎石，不小心把这家伙的腿给弄伤了，只能在...

choice_prompt:29:1411424024.text: Anyway, there was some rubble, and this fella hurt his leg. We need to rest here for a bit before we can move on...
choice_prompt:29:1411424024.source_cn: 就是刚刚这边有碎石，不小心把这家伙的腿给弄伤了，只能在这歇会儿……

say:30:1411424025:1.text: Once you're all healed up, evacuate the area. It's still dangerous here.
say:30:1411424025:1.source_cn: 嗯，治好伤你们就尽快撤离，无论如何，这附近还比较危险。
